EmailTemplate.subject: We missed you at our “Automate Third-Party & Sponsor Invoicing to Increase Cash Flow” webinar!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
We missed you! Our "Automate Third-Party & Sponsor Invoicing to Increase Cash Flow" webinar highlighted how leading higher education institutions are simplifying the invoicing and payment process for sponsors and other third parties.
Our client panelists included:
- Jino George, Billing & Student Accounts at Columbia University
- LeeAnn Pickett, Assistant Director Student Business Services at Texas A&M University
- Corey Jackson, Director of Operations at University of Pittsburgh
Here are links to the webinar recording <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-recording-automate-third-party-sponsor-invoicing-to-increase-cash-flow]]> and slideshow presentation <[[https://more.flywire.com/rs/372-QSQ-649/images/Webinar - Flywire EDU Third-Party Invoicing.pptx %281%29.pdf?version=0]]>.
Have questions? If you are a Flywire client, please reach out to your Relationship Manager. If not, just reply to this email and we’ll connect you with someone who can help.
Have a great day! Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States
